program_full_name: STAR+PLUS Home and Community Based Services
administered_by: the Texas Health and Human Services Commission, through managed care organizations that carry out the eligibility determination and coordinate services
eligibility_threshold: Texas does not publish a separate, lower functional threshold for dementia. Assessment for STAR+PLUS HCBS begins only when a person's name reaches the top of the program interest list; the managed care organization then carries out the eligibility determination.
asset_limit_single: Not published on the cited eligibility handbook section; set by Texas Medicaid financial eligibility rules
asset_limit_couple: Not published on the cited eligibility handbook section; spousal impoverishment rules apply
look_back_period: Not published on the cited eligibility handbook section; standard Medicaid transfer-of-asset rules apply
application_process: Ask to be placed on the STAR+PLUS HCBS interest list by contacting the HHSC Interest List Management unit, or the managed care organization directly if the person is already enrolled in STAR+PLUS. Nothing else happens until the name reaches the top of that list, so getting on it early is the step that matters.
unique_feature: Texas runs the programme from an interest list rather than open enrolment, and the wait is the defining feature of applying - families who assume they can apply when care is needed find the assessment cannot even begin until their turn comes.

administered_by: the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS), through contracted managed care program contractors
eligibility_threshold: Arizona does not publish a separate, lower functional threshold for dementia on the source cited here. ALTCS requires a medical and functional assessment establishing a need for nursing-facility level of care, alongside Medicaid financial eligibility.
asset_limit_single: Not published on the cited page; set by AHCCCS financial eligibility rules, which are revised annually
asset_limit_couple: Not published on the cited page; spousal impoverishment rules apply
look_back_period: Not published on the cited page; standard Medicaid transfer-of-asset rules apply
application_process: Apply through AHCCCS for an ALTCS determination, which includes a medical and functional assessment as well as the financial review. Confirm current figures and criteria with AHCCCS directly, as the programme's dollar thresholds change each year.
unique_feature: ALTCS is a single statewide long-term care programme delivered through contracted managed care organisations rather than a standalone waiver a family enrols in separately.
